title: FINAL CALL: MESSAGE TO THE BLACK MAN

sense.text: “They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.” They provoked him with strange gods. Christianity is a false religion, the religion of Caesar Borgia, and all of that is BS. But this class is for our Muslim brothers: the Shiite Muslims, the Sunni Muslims, the NOI Muslims. Listen to what God has to say in the scriptures.

“They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up.” New gods. Islam is a new religion, the newest religion. It was established in 622 AD by Muhammad.

The history bears it out. Muhammad, the Arabian impostor, appeared in the early part of the seventh century and established a new religion, and it made its progress in the world by force of arms. There was no voting and no choice: we were forced to become Muslims. When the white man enslaved us, he forced us to worship Caesar Borgia. When the Arabs enslaved us, they forced us to worship Allah. Both were slave masters. Pre-Islamic Arabia and Egypt were the end points of a slave trade out of the Sudan and Somalia, the land of the blacks, and out of Ethiopia; the Habashas filled the slave markets of Mecca, and Muhammad looked on slavery as part of the natural order of things. When you go into the roots of Islam, we were slaves. That cannot be our religion. This is the history Malcolm X, Elijah Muhammad, Farrakhan and Wallace D. Fard did not bring out.

After the destruction of Jerusalem in 70 AD, many of our people fled to Arabia, not only into Africa. Muhammad at first treated them with great attention, ordered his followers to pray toward the temple of Jerusalem, and adopted many of their customs; the Arabian writers say this nation sent twelve of their doctors to help him compile the Quran. Muhammad took monotheism from the Jewish confession, Hear, O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one; he took the Jewish calendar, the day of atonement and the Sabbath. That is why Muslims and Israelites look alike: they face Mecca, we face Jerusalem; they pray five times a day, we pray three; they don’t eat pork, we don’t eat pork. Muhammad copied what he saw the Israelites doing. The source always goes back to the Bible.

precepts.why: “Thou shalt have no other gods before me.” The Lord always told the Israelites this. Our Muslim brothers may say Allah is the one true God. Is that truth? Is Allah the God we are supposed to be serving? No. Allah is one of the strange gods, the other gods Israel was commanded not to have before the Most High.

“And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.” Gods, plural: these are false gods. In the land of our captivity we would serve gods of wood and of stone.

Remember, Islam was started in 622 AD by Muhammad. It is one of those new gods that came newly up, made by the hands of men.

sense.text:
“The Lord shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.” In our captivity we would serve other gods, wood and stone.

The wood religion is Christianity: think of the wooden beads the Puerto Ricans love to wear around their neck. The stone religion is Islam: what is the famous stone they have to kiss? The Kaaba stone. Remember that: wood is the Christian religions, stone is Islam.

Islam started around 622 AD, and from 639 to 709 AD the Arabs conquered North Africa. Islam is a violent religion; they had to kill a lot of our people. The general Amr led the invasion into Egypt in December 639 AD, then took Tunisia and western Libya and forced the people to pay tribute, three hundred and sixty slaves from each region. That is how many North Africans became Muslim, and a lot of those taken were our people, because by then we had already left Jerusalem and come into those lands. Egypt had been Ham’s, then Esau took it over (Alexander the Great in 333 BC, and the Ptolemies after him; Cleopatra was an Edomite woman, her father a Greek), and at last the Arabs took it over. That is why Morocco, Libya and Egypt are Arabs today.

Even after the last slave ship sailed west, Arab dhows were still moving our people out of Zanzibar, Mombasa and the East African ports, packed like sardines. At Fort Jesus in Mombasa there is a door of no return just like Elmina Castle in Ghana: in Ghana it was Esau, the Portuguese; in Kenya it was the Arabs. That is why we travel: in those places we see the impact of Deuteronomy 28.

precepts.why: “And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.” We were scattered among all people because of slavery: they carried us in slave ships from one end of the earth to the other. And everywhere we were scattered we served other gods, the wood and the stone, Christianity and Islam.

“And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.” When you examine our people, we always tried to follow the other races. We never wanted to stay with our God. We have always become idolaters, serving wood and stone like the families of the countries around us.

“For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.” There are nations that hate God; everybody does not love God. “They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.” We are the hidden ones, because what is hidden is that blacks and Hispanics are the real Jews. The crafty counsel against us comes down to one word: slavery.

“They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.” We did not remember that we are the Israelites. We call ourselves Jamaicans, Haitians, Guyanese, Trinidadians, and take pride in those countries, and our people are in Iraq, in India, in Papua New Guinea, because we have been scattered.

“They are confederate against thee: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites.” Edom is the first nation named: the white man is the first nation against our people. Number two is the Ishmaelites, the Arabs, and that is who we are dealing with today. They do not love us. In the African countries that embraced Islam, in Morocco, in Libya, they are still enslaving our people. Yemen, Saudi Arabia: Islam is the religion of our oppressors, just as Christianity is the religion of our oppressors. The Arabs who own the delis and grocery stores in our neighborhoods have no respect for our people; they let the brothers sell drugs so their store is protected and they make their money, and they won’t even put the change in your hand.

“Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image.” That standing image is what they rear up at Mecca on the yearly Hajj, and our people go and worship it. They fight to kiss that stone. That is idolatry, one word. This is not the black man’s religion. Where is the black man? He’s waiting in the back while the Arabs go first. Malcolm X saw that when he went to Mecca and it shocked him, because Islam is not the same as the Nation of Islam.

“Saying to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth.” The Bible says not to worship wood and stone. Why does it say to a stone, “Thou hast brought me forth”? Because as a Muslim you have to make the Hajj and go and visit that Kaaba stone; it is one of the tenets of Islam. The Bible says do not do this. This is idolatry.

“In the ways hast thou sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness.” Who sat for them? We the Israelites did. We sat and learned from the Arabians, and what did the Arabians teach us? Islam.

sense.text: “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem.” Joel sees a vision. Judah and Jerusalem is Jews and Gentiles, Judah and Ephraim: black and Latino.

“I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat.” God will gather all nations into the Middle East, and we are seeing it now: Trump is showing the world that they will defend Israel regardless of what the other nations think. That war is getting closer and closer. Why hasn’t it popped off? Because more of our people have to repent; the Lord is being patient so our people can change.

“And will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.” God’s heritage is Israel, scattered among the nations. The land has been parted between the Arabs and the Israelis. When Netanyahu bombed Gaza back to the stone age, the Lord moved his spirit to do it, so the world could see that Amalek, the so-called Jew, is the devil: they killed children, men and women and did not stop. That is what will bring all nations to the Middle East.

“And they have cast lots for my people.” They sold blacks: they sold us in Zanzibar, in Madagascar, in Kenya, in South Africa. “And have given a boy for an harlot”: they turned the boys into breeders. “And sold a girl for wine”: prostitution. “That they might drink”: when you have women and alcohol, what happens? Sex, rape. Our women were raped.

“Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine?” Tyre and Zidon are the Hamitic nations, the Africans that sold our people. Palestine is the Arabs. “Will ye render me a recompence?” God is asking, are you going to pay me back for not choosing you? “Swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head.”

“Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.” The Grecians are the white men, the Greeks. Our people were sold far from their border.

That is the history most of the Muslim brothers in the street will not talk to you about, the evils the Arabs did and are doing to our brothers, because it makes Islam look bad. They will tell you Islam is the chosen religion. It is not. The Bible is the source; the Most High picked the children of Israel.

precepts.why:
“But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how that the Lord doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.” People say black people sold black people. No: it was the Africans that sold the Jews. There is a difference between the Israelites and the Africans.

A lot of our people are in Africa, calling themselves Kenyans, Congolese, Liberians, Ghanaians, because they grew up saying they are African. There are more of our people in Africa than here in America. Africa is far bigger than the white man’s map shows it: the flight from Kenya to Morocco was eleven or twelve hours, when crossing America from New York to LA is five and a half. We have more ground to cover. Get passports, travel, and gather the twelve tribes; you are not too old. Moses was eighty.

sense.text:
In his autobiography Malcolm X said the streets around his temple were full of our brainwashed black brothers and sisters, drinking, cursing, fighting and using dope, and he knew the negroes in those streets: Harlem or Detroit were no different. It is the same today. When we march in Miami, Dallas, Baltimore, Chicago, LA, Oakland, Houston, it is the same mentality.

“Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets.” Whatever city you go to, you see blacks and Hispanics on the street corners. What Malcolm X saw in his time, we still see today. “As a wild bull in a net”: God compares the mentality of the black man to a wild bull, like the bull charging the red cape. “They are full of the fury of the Lord, the rebuke of thy God.” That is why when white people see black people they do the fake smile: I don’t want no problems.

Malcolm X believed in the truth in the Bible but not the lies the white man put in it, and he preached that the so-called Negroes are Lazarus, the dry bones in the valley, the prodigal son, the lost sheep. He was quoting the Bible. He knew something, but he could not fully piece it together. The Lord used him; he put his life on the line, and his mission was to make it easier for the Israelites later.

“But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing.” We saw the spirit he had on him: he had zeal. It is always good to be zealous in a good thing.

“For my son Jesus shall be revealed with those that be with him.” Those with him are the apostles. “And they that remain shall rejoice within four hundred years”: from Ezra writing this to Christ’s coming was about four hundred years.
“After these years shall my son Christ die, and all men that have life.” Christ died and was resurrected. All men that have life are the apostles and disciples after Christ.

“And the world shall be turned into the old silence seven days, like as in the former judgments: so that no man shall remain.” The truth would stop. The true understanding that we are the Israelites would not be taught anymore, and the world would descend into the dark ages, the middle ages. Seven days stands for a certain amount of time.

precepts.why:
Because the truth would not be taught, there would be a thirst for knowledge. “Behold, the days come, saith the Lord God, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the Lord.” Not food, not water: the word.

That is why in the fifties and sixties our brothers were seeking for truth. There was a famine; black men and black women were being oppressed, and racism was right in our face. So they resorted to Islam, because they were seeking knowledge.

“And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the Lord, and shall not find it.” They would not find it, because the truth lies in the Bible the way the Israelites are teaching it. This is the true understanding.

sense.text: “The hand of the Lord was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the Lord, and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones.” Ezekiel is in a vision. He walks by the valley of dry bones; imagine the smell. “And, lo, they were very dry.” He wrote it down for us. Malcolm X told our people they were the dry bones in the valley, and he was referencing this chapter.

“Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord God, thou knowest.” “Prophesy upon these bones”: the Lord is telling him to teach these bones the word of God. “O ye dry bones, hear the word of the Lord.” Not the word of Islam, not the word of Caesar Borgia: the word of the Lord.

“Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live.” The breath is the laws of God. “And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.”

Ezekiel 37 is the timeline of the development of the black and Hispanic race. By the end of the parable we understand we are the Israelites. But in this part of the vision we did not yet understand what we had to do as Israelites: the sinews come first, a form of identity, but no breath, because we were not truly following God the right way.

“So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.” “Lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.”

The skin and the flesh were there, the identity was there, but no breath, no knowledge. At one point we understood we were Black Panthers: have pride in being black. At one point we understood we must follow Allah, the NOI: have pride in being black, raise your children, teach your wives correctly. We had skin, but no breath. The Muslim brothers in the street taught family, discipline and structure, but there was no breath. Ezekiel saw the transition of the children of Israel, and this is where Ezekiel 37 stands with the Nation of Islam.

Does the Bible deal with family? Yes, it does. Malcolm X did not fully understand. “Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.” That has always been a problem for our sisters: submitting. Submission goes into respect. Islam understood there was a problem and addressed it, but did not understand how to deal with it, because they did not understand the Bible.
“Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.” You can become bitter against your wife if you do not apply the laws of God; fighting consistently leads to bitterness.

“Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.” The Bible deals with family. Our brothers in the NOI did not know how to bring it out of God’s word. That is our job.

“Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.” The NOI understood there was a problem between fathers and children, but they did not know how to use the Bible to address it. That is our job.

precepts.why:
“In three things I was beautified, and stood up beautiful both before God and men: the unity of brethren, the love of neighbours, a man and a wife that agree together.” Family is important. In the sixties they understood the unity of brethren; the Black Panthers and the sisters who were with us. They understood unity but did not know how to use the Bible to explain it.

There has always been a problem between the black man and the black woman when it comes to agreeing. We have to deal with it according to the Bible: husband and wife have to come together in what God says. The little the NOI did know was that we are the children of Israel. How did Malcolm X know that? Because the Israelites were already on the streets teaching it. Aba Bivens, Eber ben Yamin, was the first to teach that blacks, Latinos and the Native Americans of the Americas are Israelites; he was assaulted by members of the Nation of Islam in New Jersey because he publicly and biblically denounced Islam as a false religion of the Arabs. Yaquab, one of Bishop Nathanyel’s elders, met with Malcolm X and showed him that we are the Israelites, and Nation of Islam members came to the Israelite school to learn the Bible. The Lord put the NOI on the map, but they learned it from us.

sense.text:
Malcolm X told the wives to have an hour for reading, so they could carry an intelligent adult conversation with their husbands, and said that is one of the reasons for trouble in the house. It is true. Read the scriptures, watch the class, talk with your husband about what you learned. No man wants to come home after eight or sixteen hours to talk about diapers. Hell no. How does a wife in the truth get to the level of calling her husband a turd? Fighting, not studying and reading together, holding on to grudges: he didn’t acknowledge me, so I’m not going to give him no sex. Don’t compare your husband to an officer who breaks down the scriptures; when he comes home from camp, talk about his camp video even if it got 250 views. Win him with respect, love and peace, and encourage him in why the Most High called him.

“Every wise woman buildeth her house.” You sisters have to learn, as Israelite women, to build your house. Get around the senior women, speak with them, and learn how to build your house.

precepts.why: “The grace of a wife delighteth her husband, and her discretion will fatten his bones.” Discretion comes from discreet: know how to speak, know when to speak, know how to cheer up your husband. Why? Because the Lord has called these men gold.

“I will make a man more precious than fine gold.” That man is the Israelite man. We don’t need any other book: this book says the black man is gold. You don’t see us in our full glory yet, but you see the work we are putting in, recruiting and gathering the people. The Lord is going to use Israelite men to change this whole world and bring this place down, before men are sent to prison and persecuted. Believe it and see the vision; don’t measure it by your age or your knee pain.

While the Lord uses the men, the sisters have to back them up, because this job is not easy. To support us you have to read, study, fast, respect, pray and apply. Support the troops.

sense.text:
Khalid Muhammad of the NOI said he was the black Jew, and called them the so-called Jews because we are the true Jews, the true Hebrews. He learned that from us, from the elders of the Bishop who were teaching in the street. Farrakhan too told the crowd there are people in America like the children of Israel: the two most popular leaders of the Nation of Islam resorted to the Bible, so the Quran cannot be the book. Khalid Muhammad was demoted and suspended by Farrakhan in 1994 over a speech in which he called the Jews bloodsuckers of the black community and the Pope a no good cracker; Professor Griff was fired from Public Enemy in 1989 for the same. Who got upset? Amalek, because the truth that they are not the Jews was coming out. He was used, but he did not fully understand how to use the Bible; that is why he told the Israelites they had the knowledge but were too brutish with it.

That is why the Bishop says use the words of the Bible, and they can’t get you. Stay in the Bible and let God speak. “I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.” That is thus saith the Lord.

precepts.why: “Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.” We have to use what the Bible says, and they cannot get you. The Nation of Islam is not the religion for our brothers; Islam is not the religion for our brothers. It is the Bible, and we must use God’s words, not our own.

sense.text:
The NOI spoke about wives, children and family, much as we do, but they did not understand how to explain it from the true source, the Bible. It starts here.

“For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last.” Last. We were meant to be last; the Lord said, I’m going to save them last. That is why everybody is talking now about the Israelites and the marches. In the last days, the apostles will be back on the earth. “As it were appointed to death: for we are made a spectacle unto the world, and to angels, and to men.”

precepts.why: “My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.” We are God’s sheep. Some of us were Muslims and some were Christians, but we heard God’s voice that we are the true Jews, and we follow him.

sense.text: What is our job as Israelites? “Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor.” Bring in. Do you know the honor it is to be used to bring somebody in? That is what we want to be used for. Our job is to bring people in. You sisters are being used too: when you hand a flyer, that flyer could change a life, because you are bringing them in.

precepts.why: “Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death.” That is what we are out here to do: convert sinners and save lives.

We bring them in to the sanctuary of God, to this truth. “If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children. When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me.” The psalmist saw the wicked living prosperous, cars, sex and money everywhere, and it was too painful to understand, until he understood that death comes with all of it. “Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.” Until I came into an IUIC school. But for them to come in, somebody has to bring them in.

Here is another place we have to go to bring them in. “But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses.” We are robbed and spoiled, snared in the traps of this society, and we fill the majority of the prisons. “They are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.” Somebody has to go and bring them in: the brothers in the streets, in the prisons, in the jails, wherever they are.

sense.text:
Do you want to be used for good? Aren’t you tired of sin, of feeling weak because you gave in to it? Then stop making excuses and put in the work for the body, whatever your age. Is there a law saying don’t teach anybody over 85? A brother in this room was doing the work at 77.

“Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope.” The strong hold is the Bible. We are not physically in prison, but we are prisoners of hope. “Even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee.”

“When I have bent Judah for me.” That American black man is hardheaded, so the Lord has to bend his stubborn mind. “Filled the bow with Ephraim”: we need help from the Latinos; we can’t do it alone. “And raised up thy sons, O Zion”: blacks and Hispanics. “Against thy sons, O Greece.” We are not using physical weapons; we use the Bible. “And made thee as the sword of a mighty man.”

precepts.why: Everybody in this room was called from the womb. “Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee.” He already knew your name, and your name ain’t Tyrone and it ain’t Chantel. “And before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee.” He told the angels how old you would be when you came into the truth. Older brothers wish they had come in younger, but you had to be ripened: the Lord needed you to come in at 43, at 12, at 91, or to be born into it. That is the Lord’s choice.

“Listen, O isles, unto me”: that is why we have to travel to all the islands, because Israelites are there too. “And hearken, ye people, from far”, far from your homeland Jerusalem. “The Lord hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.” Isaiah said what Jeremiah said: before your mother pushed you out, you already had a name.

“And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword”: that sharp sword is the Bible, God’s words when we preach. “In the shadow of his hand hath he hid me.” The Lord is covering us. He has a weapon he can’t show the world yet; if he let you see these brothers they would unleash on you, so he hides them. “And made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me.” A quiver holds the arrows: we are weapons.

sense.text:
Weapons to do what? “The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.” That is the weapon. You have the potential to convert sinners, and that makes you dangerous: you can help a brother or sister change their life.

How do you win a soul? Ultimately it is the word of God. We are fishers of men: the captains, stopping at a gas station on the road, handed out flyers on their own, before anyone told them to. You take every opportunity to help somebody change their life. You don’t wait till Saturday or till you feel like it. You are on duty all day.

precepts.why: When one sinner repents, the angels rejoice. “I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.” And verse 10: “there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.” The heavenly host is happy when you change your life and get it together.

The Lord gave us the secret of how to win souls. “By long forbearing is a prince persuaded.” By patience. You can’t walk up to the ambassador of Saudi Arabia or to Putin and tell him what to do; you have to persuade him, and persuading takes patience. You can’t be brutish. Many brothers love to grab the mic and bring out the scriptures, but with what intent: to win the argument, or to win the brother or sister?

When the brother was teaching Khalid Muhammad too hard, Kazak, the more senior elder, took over with more dialogue and more listening, and the spirit was winning him over. Learn to be patient, to listen, to study the person and know when to present the truth. When someone won’t take the flyer, don’t take it personal, and don’t chase them down; say, maybe next time. That shows belief. If you get mad now you close the door on them; what if Christ had closed the door on you? Let the Lord do his part: no man can come unto Christ except the Father draw him.

sense.text: When we go out and teach, a lot of war and death is going to happen, and judgment will come from the east, even over to here. “The burden of the desert of the sea.” Isaiah sees something coming from the desert, and who dwells in the desert places? The Arabs. “As whirlwinds in the south pass through”: judgment. “So it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.”

“A grievous vision is declared unto me”: it scared Isaiah. “The treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously”: that is America. “And the spoiler spoileth.” Then Isaiah names the names: “Go up, O Elam”, India and Pakistan; “besiege, O Media”, Iran.

“Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth.” His guts hurt. “I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it. My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me.”

“Prepare the table”: prepare the Bible. “Watch in the watchtower”: soldiers in a watchtower in the desert country watch for danger coming. “Arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield”: they are going into war.

“Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.” The watchman sees a chariot of horses, asses and camels coming with speed, men running because war has taken place, and asks what happened. “Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.” He saw the fall of America.
“That which I have heard of the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.” It was war and destruction, and Isaiah saw it in the desert countries and wrote it down.

“The burden of Dumah.” Dumah comes from the Arabs, in Genesis 25. “He calleth to me out of Seir”: Seir is where Edom dwells. “Watchman, what of the night?” They had just seen war. “The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.”

“The burden upon Arabia.” So Islam cannot be the way: judgment is coming for Saudi Arabia, for Libya, for Iran, for Pakistan. The travelling companies of Dedanim are the Arabs; the land of Tema is Edom. “For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.” The swords are war.

“And all the glory of Kedar shall fail.” Kedar is Saudi Arabia. “The mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the Lord God of Israel hath spoken it.” He saw judgment on America and judgment on the Arab countries. So our Muslim brothers have to leave the NOI and join us, because Farrakhan, Malcolm X and the Lord himself have always said: you are the children of Israel.

All through the Quran they speak of the Bible and the children of Israel; never forget that we have the true and living book. “Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.” Who are the saints? We are.

“Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth.” Persecution will come for the number of souls we are going to win. It came to the Black Panthers, to Marcus Garvey, to the Nation of Islam, and it is going to come to the Israelites. “Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours”: those that die in the Lord, the martyrs, rest from their labour. “And their works do follow them.”
